title: Gendered Pathways in AI Companionship: Cross-Community Behavior and Toxicity Patterns on Reddit

bias_targets.methodology: Inferring user gender using a DeBERTa-based text classifier and comparing toxicity levels (using the detoxify model) and emotional expressions (using a RoBERTa-based emotion classifier) between male- and female-authored content across various AI-companionship and gender-oriented Reddit communities.
